notes.title: Servers for Tank of War-VR shut down Notification
notes.notes:
As the authorization term is coming，we have to make a decision to Tank of War-VR purchasing function will be closed on November 15, 2019. The users who have purchased it can still play normally.
And the servers will be shut down on Dec.31st,2019. 
We are sorry for this decision and Thanks for your accompany.
